title: PropertiesPanel: bitmap and video display-object views
description: PropertiesPanel.getView() has no case for 'bitmap' or 'video' display object types — both fall through to 'frame' (show nothing useful). When the user selects a bitmap instance on stage they see the empty frame panel instead of bitmap-specific controls. Scope: (1) Add a 'bitmap' view to PropertiesPanel showing: x/y/w/h numeric fields (linked to onUpdateObject), alpha/transparency slider, and a 'Swap Bitmap...' button that opens a picker from library BitmapItems. (2) Add a 'video' view showing: x/y/w/h, instance name field. Wire the new views through getView() and render them in the main switch. Update PropertiesPanelProps with the missing onSwapBitmap callback. Add Vitest unit tests covering the new view dispatch. Acceptance: selecting a placed bitmap on stage shows the bitmap properties panel with editable x/y fields; selecting a placed video shows the video properties panel; no regressions in existing PropertiesPanel unit tests.
